# Nemotron-3.5-Lightning tokenizer parity corpus (one case per line).
#   - a line starting with '#' is a comment
#   - \n, \t and \\ in a line are unescaped to a newline, a tab and a backslash
#     by tools/nemotron_tokenizer_capture.py, so multi-line text fits one line
# Every case is encoded by the checkpoint's own tokenizer.json and by the
# engine's bridge (tokenizer_kind 9, MistralWordStream); ids must match exactly.
# ASCII prose
The capital of France is
Hello, world!
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
# contractions: this pre-tokenizer has NO contraction suffix, so "don't" splits
# at the punctuation run rather than staying a single word
don't stop, it's 3.14% of the total...
we've can't they're I'll he'd
# code and punctuation
def f(x):\n    return x**2 + 1\n
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 10;
json {"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": null}
\x = a + b * c / d - e
url https://example.com/p?q=1&r=2#frag
# digits: one digit per number word in this pre-tokenizer
Numbers 1234567 3.14159 -42 1,000,000
# case runs
MixedCASE CamelCase snake_case kebab-case
# whitespace runs and line breaks
  leading and trailing   
\tTabbed\tline
multi\nline\r\ncrlf
# non-Latin
Переменная = 42
变量名 = 42 中文测试
日本語のテスト、東京。
emoji 🚀 test ünïcode Ünïcödé façade naïve
# single characters and short fragments
a
x
 \n
